MATERIAL_PREP.heading: Prepare materials for: {productLine}.
MATERIAL_PREP.l1: Pull fabric, wood, foam, and hardware per the bill of materials.
MATERIAL_PREP.l2: Label kits for carpentry, painting, and upholstery.
MATERIAL_PREP.l3: Flag shortages to purchasing before releasing the kit.

CARPENTRY.heading: Carpentry for: {productLine}.
CARPENTRY.l1: Cut and assemble frames to drawing dimensions.
CARPENTRY.l2: Sand all visible surfaces; check joints and squareness.
CARPENTRY.l3: Stage completed frames for painting / upholstery.

PAINTING.heading: Finishing / paint for: {productLine}.
PAINTING.l1: Apply primer and finish coats per color reference.
PAINTING.l2: Allow full cure time before handing off to assembly.
PAINTING.l3: Protect finished surfaces for transport to next stage.

UPHOLSTERY.heading: Upholstery for: {productLine}.
UPHOLSTERY.l1: Cut fabric to pattern; match grain and color batch.
UPHOLSTERY.l2: Foam and cover to the approved sample.
UPHOLSTERY.l3: Inspect seams and staples before assembly handoff.

ASSEMBLY.heading: Assemble: {productLine}.
ASSEMBLY.l1: Join carpentry, paint, and upholstery components.
ASSEMBLY.l2: Fit hardware and verify dimensions against the order.
ASSEMBLY.l3: Move complete unit to inspection with paperwork.

INSPECTION.heading: Quality inspection for: {productLine}.
INSPECTION.l1: Run the stage checklist; photograph defects if any.
INSPECTION.l2: Pass only if dimensions, finish, and fabric match the order.
INSPECTION.l3: Fail with clear rework notes for the owning stage.

PACKAGING.heading: Package: {productLine}.
PACKAGING.l1: Wrap and crate for safe transport; add corner protection.
PACKAGING.l2: Attach packing list and factory order label.
PACKAGING.l3: Stage for delivery only after QC pass.

DELIVERY.heading: Deliver: {productLine}.
DELIVERY.l1: Confirm address, window, and contact on the sales order.
DELIVERY.l2: Collect POD signature / photo on delivery.

DEFAULT.l1: Follow the shop drawing and order specifications.
DEFAULT.l2: Update task progress and attach required photos before complete.
